name: Exodus
title: Exodus — Redemption Out of Bondage
tagline: Yahweh saves a people by blood and power, then dwells among them.

date.range_display: Setting: Egypt → Sinai. Composition: Mosaic. Exodus date debated (early c. 1446 BC / late c. 1260 BC); either way the theology is liberation by blood.
date.debate: Setting: Egypt → Sinai. Composition: Mosaic. Exodus date debated (early c. 1446 BC / late c. 1260 BC); either way the theology is liberation by blood.

audience: Redeemed Israel learning to be a holy nation.
purpose: Show salvation by substitution and covenant law under a holy God.
christ: Passover Lamb (1 Cor 5:7); true Tabernacle; Mediator greater than Moses.
spirit: Bezalel filled with the Spirit for tabernacle work (31:3); God’s presence leading.
jesus_in_this_book: Passover Lamb (1 Cor 5:7); true Tabernacle; Mediator greater than Moses.
how_to_read: Blood first, then law. Presence is the goal.
watchman_charge: Remember what enslaved you and Who bought you out. Keep Passover central.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
